examples.chinese: A:對不起？ B:沒關係。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ? B: Méi guānxi.
examples.english: A: Sorry? B: It's okay.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠的工作很辛苦，可是錢很多，所以很多人願意做。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì qián hěn duō, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén yuànyì zuò.
examples.english: The work at that factory is very hard, but the pay is good, so many people are willing to do it.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english: Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 開早餐店很辛苦，大清早老闆就得起來準備。
examples.pinyin: Kāi zǎocāndiàn hěn xīnkǔ, dàqīngzǎo lǎobǎn jiù děi qǐlái zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Running a breakfast shop is very hard; early in the morning, the owner has to get up to prepare.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 學校安排我們到鄉下當「一日農民」，體驗農夫的辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào ānpái wǒmen dào xiāngxià dāng “yī rì nóngmín”, tǐyàn nóngfū de xīnkǔ.
examples.english: The school arranged for us to go to the countryside to be a 'farmer for a day' and experience the hardships of farmers.

examples.chinese: 射箭看來容易，但想把箭射好，就得辛苦地練習。
examples.pinyin: Shèjiàn kànlái róngyì, dàn xiǎng bǎ jiàn shè hǎo, jiù děi xīnkǔ de liànxí.
examples.english: Archery seems easy, but if you want to shoot arrows well, you have to practice hard.

items.wordHook: 辛(pungent) + 苦(bitter) → a life that tastes pungent and bitter: 辛苦(hard; tough).

examples.chinese: 這家飯店又方便又乾淨，而且不貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yòu fāngbiàn yòu gānjìng, érqiě bú guì.
examples.english: This hotel is both convenient and clean, and moreover not expensive.

examples.chinese: 這張椅子不太乾淨，我要那張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yǐzi bù tài gānjìng, wǒ yào nà zhāng.
examples.english: This chair is not very clean; I want that one.

examples.chinese: 是因為吃的東西不乾淨嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shì yīnwèi chī de dōngxi bù gānjìng ma?
examples.english: Is it because of having contaminated food?

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: A:對不起？ B:沒關係。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ? B: Méi guānxi.
examples.english: A: Sorry? B: It's okay.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.
examples.english: The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

items.wordHook: Combining 日(sun) and 記(record): 日記 means diary.

examples.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
examples.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
examples.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
examples.pinyin: Qiúyuán de biǎoxiàn ràng jiàoliàn bùduàn yáotóu, bìng biǎoshì děi jiāqiáng píngcháng de xùnliàn.
examples.english: The players' performance made the coach constantly shake his head, and he indicated that they need to strengthen their regular training.

examples.chinese: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng rù huìyuán bìng xiǎngshòu wǒmen jiànshēnfáng suǒ tígōng de fúwù, qǐng nín dào guìtái bànlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to become a member and enjoy the services provided by our gym, please go to the counter to handle it.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

examples.chinese: 公司如果關心客戶並達成他們的需求，對業務或多或少有好處。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī rúguǒ guānxīn kèhù bìng dáchéng tāmen de xūqiú, duì yèwù huòduōhuòshǎo yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: If a company cares about its customers and meets their needs, it is more or less beneficial to the business.

examples.chinese: 擁有一架小飛機並親自在天空上駕駛，一直是孫小姐的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Yōngyǒu yí jià xiǎo fēijī bìng qīnzì zài tiānkōng shàng jiàshǐ, yìzhí shì Sūn xiǎojiě de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Owning a small airplane and piloting it in the sky oneself has always been Miss Sun's dream.

examples.chinese: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tèdì dào dāngdì de huáxuě yòngpǐn gōngchǎng cānguān, bìng jìnxíng jìshù jiāoliú.
examples.english: We specially visited a local ski equipment factory and conducted technical exchanges.

examples.chinese: 無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, tā dōu huì gēn fùmǔ shāngliang, bìng cānkǎo tāmen de yìjiàn.
examples.english: No matter what happens, she will discuss it with her parents and refer to their opinions.

examples.chinese: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
examples.pinyin: Nǎiyóu bùdàn zhǒnglèi duō, bìngqiě shì zuò tiándiǎn shí bùnéng shǎo de cáiliào.
examples.english: Butter not only comes in many types, but is also an indispensable ingredient when making desserts.

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

examples.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
examples.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

examples.chinese: 雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán shòudào le zhòngdà de cuòzhé, kěshì tā bìng méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Although he suffered a major setback, he actually did not give up his dream.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

examples.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，擁有和平的日子其實是最單純的幸福。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, yǒngyǒu hépíng de rìzi qíshí shì zuì dānchún de xìngfú.
examples.english: To me, having peaceful days is actually the simplest happiness.

examples.chinese: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú rénrén dōu fāhuī rénxìng měihǎo de yī miàn, jiù néng gěi shèhuì dàilái hépíng.
examples.english: If everyone brings out the beautiful side of human nature, then it can bring peace to society.

examples.chinese: 這些筆電和平板都比以前的輕。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē bǐdiàn hé píngbǎn dōu bǐ yǐqián de qīng.
examples.english: These laptops and tablets are all lighter than previous ones.

items.wordHook: An 甲(armor) vest wraps 一(one) torso → the inner 里(li).
